messages:
Priya Kapoor: Quick heads-up — we need a finalized set of private-offer renewal templates + announcement cadence for the ‘Skyline’ program (cloud marketplace + HW SI bundle). Goal: one consistent partner-facing email + partner portal copy + a customer renewal cadence. Can someone own drafting this? Target: draft by EOW for partner QA :calendar:

Jonas Reed: I can take the draft email + marketplace listing copy. Will need the renewal discount ladder and SKU mapping from finance.

Lena Ortiz: I’ll own partner portal copy + the internal ops checklist (how we trigger marketplace private-offer renewals). Will sync with Marco on timing windows.

Marco Chen: I’ll pull the SKU mapping + committed-spend tiers and confirm which HW credits apply. ETA tomorrow noon.

Priya Kapoor: Awesome — @Jonas to email draft, @Lena portal + ops checklist, @Marco pricing table. I’ll coordinate partner comms and internal announce timeline. Target partner QA Tuesday 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Jonas Reed: Draft note (very rough):
```
Subject: Redwood — Renewal notice for your Skyline private offer
Hi {{PartnerName}},
Thanks for partnering on Skyline. Your private offer is up for renewal on {{renewal_date}}.
We recommend: 1) Renew committed spend at current tier to keep HW credits, or 2) Opt for monthly metered with a 10% onboarding credit for first 3 months.
Please review attached SKU mapping and reply if you want us to open a private-offer renewal via marketplace.
Best, Jonas
```

Lena Ortiz: I like that. Two notes: 1) remove promo always-from-product language; needs to be partner-specific, 2) add link to self-serve renewal form in first paragraph.

Marco Chen: Pricing caveat: for customers that dropped below 60% of committed usage we need a 30-day re-onboarding window; language suggestion: "If usage has dropped, we’ll review your commitment band and recommend the best path forward."

Priya Kapoor: Good catch. Can we also include an explicit renewal opt-out path for legal? Quick line: "If you prefer not to renew, notify us by {{opt_out_deadline}} and we’ll close the private offer."

Lena Ortiz: Added to ops checklist. Also recorded a suggested announcement cadence:
- Week -4: Partner notification + draft SOW/sku packet
- Week -2: Customer targeted email + portal banner
- Week 0: Renewal confirmation / private-offer update in marketplace
- Week +2: Post-renewal usage check and HW credit reconciliation

Jonas Reed: That cadence works. For marketplace we should stagger partner announces by region (NA first, then EMEA) to avoid support spikes.

Priya Kapoor: Agreed — regional stagger. Can @PartnerOps-bot schedule a recurring 30-min ops handoff meeting for Tuesdays 9am PT starting next week?

PartnerOps-bot: Scheduled: "Skyline Renewal Ops" — Tuesdays 09:00 PT, starting 4990012400. Calendar invites sent to Priya Kapoor, Jonas Reed, Lena Ortiz, Marco Chen.

Marco Chen: I’ll upload the SKU mapping CSV to the shared drive and tag you all. Quick note: some legacy SKUs have been deprecated — we need fallback SKUs in the email template.

Lena Ortiz: Put fallback SKUs in the portal table and add an FAQ entry: "What if my SKU was deprecated?" with the migration path.

Jonas Reed: Will iterate the email with placeholders for fallback SKUs + opt-out line. Plan to post first draft in #partnerships by EOD Friday.

Priya Kapoor: Perfect. Owners & deadlines: Jonas (email + marketplace copy) — EOD Fri, Marco (pricing table + SKUs) — tomorrow noon, Lena (portal + ops checklist + FAQ) — EOW, Priya (partner comms + announce schedule) — Tue partner QA. If anything slips, flag in thread. Thanks all :rocket:
